body: I think I might also experience this issue as I have a gii-generated CRUD with a gridview that has a _Showing x-y of z items_ block on the top. On my development machine it is displayed correctly but when I deploy it in production running the latest PHP 5.4 module versions I get _Showing {begin, number}-{end, number} of {totalCount, number} {totalCount, plural, one{item} other{items}}._ I have not debugged it yet but chances are it has the same problem.
@battika most probably you don't have intl at all.
@battika can you check if intl exension is installed on the server and which version it has?
@kartik-v are you using the `#` for the number of items? this is not supported with ICU < 48 as far as I remember.

@cebe ... the ICU version is 4.2. Wondering what's the option for extension development and messages (translations) then? Should we develop the extensions with < ICU 48 in mind... or can we have some function in Yii to address someway for this limitation?

BTW... [this link for ICU 4.2.1 here](http://icu.sourcearchive.com/documentation/4.2.1-3/classPluralFormat.html) shows an example with the hash.

I can check that this works - with the following format for the ICU version 4.2:

```
echo \Yii::t('app', 'There {n, plural, one{is one cat} other{are # cats}}!', ['n' => 0]);
```

instead of

```
echo \Yii::t('app', 'There {n, plural, =0{are no cats} =1{is one cat} other{are # cats}}!', ['n' => 0]);
```
1. Is there something we can update in the docs on these lines (usage for specific ICU versions)?
2. Is there a way we can let Yii tell that minimal INTL/ICU requirement is not met for the specific Yii install (either as an exception OR in the requirements.php)?
@samdark and @cebe , sorry for the delay, just came back from vacation. Yes, I do have php-intl installed, please find the version below: rpm -qa | grep php54w-intl php54w-intl-5.4.25-1.w5
